scope: AREA-01 and TERR-01 serialized fields, name resources, and runtime-consumer audit

evidence.area_inventory: Across 20 formal and 6 tutorial scenarios, all 390 area records have +0x00, +0x02 and +0x04 equal to the sequential record ID
evidence.area_negative_audit: The area accessor's city, country-title, map and automatic-corps consumers do not read runtime +0x1C/+0x20; direct table and field-address audits found no other business reader
evidence.area_names: Record type 8 resolves display/readings at messages 136/137 plus 2 times sequential ID; the TC PK catalog contains 15 names and 15 empty reading records
evidence.terrain_inventory: Across the same 26 scenarios, all 442 terrain records have +0x00/+0x02 equal to sequential ID; +0x04 is 1 for Forest and 0 for every other terrain
evidence.terrain_negative_audit: Runtime-class, global-table and exact field-address xrefs found no business reader for runtime +0x18/+0x1C, so +0x04 retains an opaque name despite its inventory pattern
evidence.terrain_names: Record type 13 resolves display names at message 704 plus sequential ID; the TC PK catalog contains 17 names

ida_changes.read_back: All four function names were resolved by address; forced recompilation of both loaders showed the serialized-field findings and name-resource formulas.
